description: This file defines the 'PieExplodedPlotAreaRenderer' class, a specialized renderer for exploded pie chart plots within the PDFsharp library. It extends 'PiePlotAreaRenderer' and calculates sector angles for pie chart segments considering exploded chart options.

classes.name: PieExplodedPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for exploded pie plot areas, responsible for calculating sector angles and handling exploded pie chart rendering logic.

methods.name: PieExplodedPlotAreaRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with rendering parameters.

methods.name: CalcSectors
methods.description: Calculates the angles and positions for each sector in the exploded pie chart, adjusting for labels and exploded offsets.
